summary: Inspected 20+ files from the 89 changed/added files in this unit (Adams1975, Schoter1996a, Kratzer1996, Elliott2020, Cooper2023, Prince1983, VanRooy2003, Arad2005, Mandelkern2022, Kamp1975, Chomsky1995, BarwiseCooper1981, Fine1975, Fitting1994, Spector2026, Middleton2026, Newman2024, DegenTonhauser2021, VonFintelGillies2021, Schoter1996b). Every file is a Lean module with definitions (inductive types, structures, functions), theorems, and proofs formalizing a specific linguistics/psychology paper. Files range from ~58 lines (Schoter1996a) to ~1600+ lines (Cooper2023, BarwiseCooper1981, Spector2026). No file is a pure import aggregator, duplicate, or declaration-free. All contain formal mathematical content (type theory, category theory, measure theory, dynamic semantics, bilattice logic, supervaluation semantics, minimalist syntax, generalized quantifier theory, etc.) applied to linguistic theory. The previous review (RRV-32ba8afead09-r7) reached the same conclusion for the earlier snapshot.
